post.description: Client Login to Blink Account on Blink Servers

unique_id.description: UUID generated and identifying the client. Pass a consistent value here to avoid repeated client verification PIN requests. Format: NAME_00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000

client_name.description: Display name in the blink app of the client

reauth.description: Should be set to true if the client is already verified. Otherwise blink keeps sending verification PINs.

200.description: Login successful. Returns account information, authentication token, and verification details.

400.description: Invalid credentials or missing required fields

post.description: Verify the PIN code sent via email or SMS for two-factor authentication. Required for new clients or when explicitly requested.
Client Logout Blink Account on Blink Servers

get.description: Retrieve Client "home screen" data. Returns detailed information about the Account including Network, Synch Module, and Camera Info.

200.description: Home screen data including account, networks, sync modules, cameras, and device limits.

get.description: Retrieve information about all networks associated with the authenticated account. Note: BlinkMonitorProtocol marks this as obsolete (replaced by homescreen endpoint) but still actively used by blinkpy implementation.

post.description: Arm system to detect motion on cameras. This call is asynchronous and is monitored by the Command Status API call using the returned Command Id.

200.description: A command object. This call is asynchronous and is monitored by the Command Status API call using the returned Command Id.

get.description: Get status of command. Commands are used to check the status of requests like arm, disarm, thumbnail creation, and video recording.

200.description: Command status with completion flag and status information

post.description: Enable motion detection for camera. Note that this does not arm the system.

200.description: A command object. This call is asynchronous and is monitored by the Command Status API call using the returned Command Id.
A command object. This call is asynchronous and is monitored by the Command Status API call using the returned Command Id.

post.description: Set the thumbnail by taking a snapshot of the current view of the camera. This call is asynchronous and is monitored by the Command Status API call using the returned Command Id.

200.description: A command object. This call is asynchronous and is monitored by the Command Status API call using the returned Command Id.

post.description: Record a video clip from the camera. This call is asynchronous and is monitored by the Command Status API call using the returned Command Id.
Ask for live video stream from camera. Returns RTSP URL for streaming.

200.description: A command object containing a Real Time Streaming Protocol (RTSP) URL

get.description: Get Media (Generally video) events since the given timestamp in the query parameter.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: A timestamp to return events since. e.g. 2020-08-03T16:50:24+0000. The official mobile client seems to use the epoch to return all available events - i.e. 1970-01-01T00:00:00+0000

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number for multiple pages of results

200.description: Media events array with pagination info

get.description: Download the actual video file for a clip. The filename is typically obtained from the media field of a VideoClip object.
Download the thumbnail image for a video clip. The filename is typically obtained from the thumbnail field of a VideoClip object.

get.summary: Get camera thumbnail image (direct media URL)
get.description: Retrieve the current thumbnail image directly from the camera. This URL format is used for direct media access with timestamp and extension parameters.
List the schedules (programs) defined for the given Network/Blink Module

200.description: An array of program objects with schedule information

post.description: Disable a specific schedule/program for the network.

get.description: Flag status for various notifications

200.description: Notification configuration flags for the account

post.description: Snooze (temporarily disable) motion-activated notifications for a camera.

get.description: Determine if a new version of the official client is available. This call does not require authentication. This information is also returned in the HomeScreen call.

200.description: Version check result with update availability information

get.description: Get valid region info for a locale. Authentication is not required. Specific use for results is unknown.

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: A Two Character country code e.g. US

200.description: Region information with preferred region and available regions

get.description: Retrieve the current configuration settings for a specific camera.

post.description: Update configuration settings for a specific camera (primarily for Catalina cameras).

get.description: Retrieve current sensor readings from the camera including battery, temperature, and signal strength.

post.description: Verify Client with PIN provided in an email. Pass a consistent Client UUID at login to avoid needing to do this more than once.

200.description: PIN verification result with validation status

get.description: Get client specific options

Retrieve the JPEG thumbnail picture of the given camera. The URL path is specified in the thumbnail attribute of the camera, for example from the HomeScreen call. Add the .jpg extension to the URL path.

TokenAuth.name: TOKEN_AUTH
TokenAuth.description: Authentication token obtained from login endpoint

UnauthorizedError.description: Authentication token is missing or invalid

new_account.description: Whether this is a new account

lockout_time_remaining.description: Seconds remaining if account is locked out

allow_pin_resend_seconds.description: Seconds before PIN can be resent

auto_delete_days.description: Days after which videos are auto-deleted

command_id.description: Command identifier for this live view session

join_available.description: Whether joining the stream is available

server.description: RTSP server URL for live stream

continue_interval.description: Interval for continue requests in seconds

continue_warning.description: Warning time before stream ends in seconds

submit_logs.description: Whether to submit logs for this session

new_command.description: Whether this is a new command

device_name.description: Name of camera that recorded clip

dow.description: Days of week when this entry applies

devices.description: Device IDs affected by this schedule entry

regions.description: Available regions mapped by region ID

registration.description: Whether registration is available in this region
